dct_description_sm: Yukon Climate Change Needs Assessment: The purpose of this project was to prepare Yukon communities for the impacts of climate change. The Yukon Climate Change Needs Assessment was conducted during 2010-2011 by the Council of Yukon First Nations (CYFN) in partnership with the Northern Climate ExChange (NCE) at Yukon College and the Climate Change Secretariat (CCS) at Yukon government. More specifically, the aim of this project was to identify priority areas of concern for Yukon communities within the context of climate change, and to provide local, regional, national, and international organizations insight into priority areas for future climate change programming.  Canada-Norway Community Twinning: It also intended to initiate a partnership with two Saami communities in Norway, enabling the sharing of climate change adaptation best practices and knowledge, building the capacities of both communities (and potentially other Northern communities, as well).
